hypotheses.justification: The proof uses hT_compact only by passing it to `abs_eigenvector_of_top_eigenvector` (JentzschProof.lean line 221). That lemma names the binder `_hT_compact` and its proof (lines 236-284) never uses it. The proof steps are: norm_abs_eq_norm, abs_inner_le_inner_abs (which uses positivity preservation), hlam₀_top, hT_sa.eq_smul_self_of_isLocalExtrOn (which needs only self-adjointness), and computing the Rayleigh quotient. The other lemma called, `ground_state_strictly_positive`, takes no compactness argument. hT_compact is not mentioned anywhere else in the statement. So the theorem holds without it. To prove it, drop the argument from the call, or remove the unused binder from abs_eigenvector_of_top_eigenvector as well (the call needs a compactness proof as long as that binder stays).
